Aisha (CSM): Quick heads-up — QBR with Meridian Health Tue 3/30 10am PT. Need a tight deck, exec asks, and an owner list. Can we consolidate asks + risks by EOD Friday?

Jon (AE): On it. I will own the 'business outcomes' slide and renewal ask section. @Priya can you lead the enablement recap?

Priya (Enablement): Yep — I'll do a 15m enablement snapshot and capture two customer quotes. Need a short usage snippet to pull into the slide.

Diego (DataOps): I can pull 30/60/90 day usage, latency p50/p95, and churn indicators. Where should I drop charts — deck skeleton or GDrive folder?

Aisha (CSM): Use the deck in #cs-decks (gdrive): https://drive.google.com/placeholder/meridian-qbr-skeleton — I'll add exec asks. Please annotate RAG for renewal risk per account.

Nora (CRO): I'll join for the exec readout. Quick question: what's our single biggest renewal risk and proposed mitigation? Need a 1-line summary for my notes.

Jon (AE): Biggest risk: integration delays for two enterprise connectors. Mitigation: dedicated onboarding runway + sandbox credits + weekly ops check-ins. I'll add bullets.

Priya (Enablement): Enablement will surface adoption blockers and top support tickets. We'll also include one short 'ask' slide for engineering: small webhook PR to reduce setup time — Diego, can you tag eng owner?

Diego (DataOps): Will tag @eng-platform in deck notes and create tracker ticket RDW-4231. Dropped preliminary charts into the GDrive (folder) and updated the skeleton.

Aisha (CSM): Action items (quick):
```
- Jon: Business outcomes slide + renewal risk bullets (due Fri 5pm PT)
- Priya: Enablement 15m snapshot + customer quotes (due Fri 5pm PT)
- Diego: Usage + latency charts; create eng ticket RDW-4231 (due Thu EOD)
- Aisha: Executive asks + invite list + rehearsal slot (due Mon)
```

redwood-sync-bot: File updated — meridian-qbr-skeleton_v3.pptx by Diego. Link: https://drive.google.com/placeholder/meridian-qbr-skeleton_v3.pptx

Aisha (CSM): Rehearsal: Mon 3/29 9am PT — please RSVP. Quick feedback capture plan: one Google Form for execs and one shorter form for engineering/ops; Priya to set up.

Priya (Enablement): On it. Will share both forms and pre-fill 3 sample questions (actionable asks + one open comment).

Jon (AE): :+1:

Nora (CRO): Please tag me in final deck by Sun so I can prep remarks and exec TL;DR.

Aisha (CSM): Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for slide ownership and asks. If anything changes, drop updates here.
